# GraphGeometryAlignment

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of aligning the geometric representation of a graph (e.g., node coordinates) with its functional dynamics, ensuring that spatial layout reflects functional interactions. Facilitates the mapping of brain-inspired functional dynamics onto physical neuromorphic hardware, improving spike-timing and connectivity efficiency in iNEST.
